direction_notes: No neural activity was measured. Anxiety scores fell from baseline to completion (HAM-A pre-post change -12.64, BAI -12.88) in an open-label, uncontrolled design.
safety_notes: All participants tolerated treatment without notable side effects; no adverse events were reported.

timing.protocol_description: The tFUS was administered 30 s on and 30 s off for 10 min; eight consecutive weekly 10-min sessions.
